When the King Comes For You, You Best Not Miss

▶ Watch the Teaser

Synopsis

A deadly game.
A digital reckoning.

When a vociferous critic of LeBron James falls prey to one of the NBA star's sadistic henchmen, he must display on-court skills of his own if he's to escape a grisly death.

Mr. H, a Frenchman, wakes up chained to a basketball court in a desolate factory. Disoriented, he quickly realizes he's been trapped in a deadly game orchestrated by a mysterious figure known as The King's Slayer.

To survive, he must make five successful three-pointers in 23 seconds — failure means a horrible death. As the odds stack against him, unsettling clues point to his toxic online obsession with LeBron James, a figure he has hated for years.

The game isn't just about survival — it's about confronting the consequences of his digital footprints, in a twisted cycle of revenge and redemption.

Director's Statement

"The concept intrigued me because it reflects the toxic side of modern online culture — the anonymous hate and obsession that can easily spiral out of control. I wanted to examine how a single act of online hate could snowball into a life-and-death situation. How much responsibility do we have for the things we say, and what happens when those words come back to haunt us?"

— Djamel Bennecib, Writer & Director
